messages.text: New season, same Man Utd story - Carrick is now firmly feeling the pressure

metadata.summary: This wasn't just a defeat. This wasn't just a collapse. This wasn't just a cup exit. Another Manchester United managerial project is heading in that one, same direction. And even Michael Carrick recognises that.
metadata.content: Man Utd 2-3 Brighton: Michael Carrick's Old Trafford tenure is only heading in one direction as Red Devils face familiar story | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis Man Utd 2-3 Brighton: Michael Carrick's Old Trafford tenure is only heading in one direction as Red Devils face familiar story Man Utd crashed out of the Carabao Cup, surrendering a two-goal lead against Brighton to lose 3-2 at Old Trafford; it is the first time in 145 attempts where United have held a two-goal lead at Old Trafford and lost, ramping up the pressure on head coach Michael Carrick Sam Blitz Football Journalist @SamBIitz Thursday 17 September 2026 00:04, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Jamie Redknapp rips into Manchester United for the way they defended in their 3-2 loss to Brighton in the Carabao Cup third round. This wasn't just a defeat. This wasn't just a collapse. This wasn't just a cup exit. Another Manchester United managerial project is heading in that one, same direction. And even Michael Carrick recognises that. "We've gone out of the cup and the feeling around the place feels bigger than that," he said. "I'm happy enough to be honest about that. That's how it feels." It's a story that's been seen before. A dismal Carabao Cup experience at the first hurdle - this time throwing away a 2-0 lead to exit to Brighton - harks back to memories of Ruben Amorim's disappointing defeat at Grimsby last year , which helped signal the beginning of the end. messages.text: Leicestershire hit with 27-point deduction for breaching pitch regulations

metadata.summary: Leicestershire County Cricket Club have been deducted 27 points and fined £5,000 for breaching pitch regulations in their victory over Glamorgan in August.
metadata.content: County Championship: Leicestershire hit with 27-point deduction and £5000 fine for breaching pitch regulations | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content County Championship: Leicestershire hit with 27-point deduction and £5000 fine for breaching pitch regulations Leicestershire have been handed a 27-point deduction and £5000 fine for breaching pitch regulations in August; Watch England's second T20 vs Sri Lanka live on Sky Sports Cricket from 6pm on Thursday (6.30pm first ball) Wednesday 16 September 2026 22:55, UK Image: Leicestershire County Cricket Club has been hit with a 27-point County Championship deduction Leicestershire County Cricket Club have been deducted 27 points and fined £5,000 for breaching pitch regulations in their victory over Glamorgan in August. In a statement on Wednesday, the club said: "The Club notes the Cricket Discipline Panel's decision, which imposes an eight-point deduction, an additional eight-point deduction suspended until the end of the 2027 season, and a financial penalty of £5000. "Under ECB Rothesay County Championship Playing Condition 16.2.6, the 19 points earned in the match concerned will also be deducted from Leicestershire CCC's 2026 Rothesay County Championship total. "Accordingly, the Club will lose 27 points overall. messages.text: Warwickshire seal two-day win over Essex to boost County Championship title hopes

metadata.summary: Warwickshire boosted their Rothesay County Championship title challenge by securing an eight-wicket win over Essex in two days.
metadata.content: County Championship: Warwickshire seal two-day win over Essex to boost title hopes as Sam Hain stars | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to content County Championship: Warwickshire seal two-day win over Essex to boost title hopes as Sam Hain stars Wednesday's County Championship cricket sees Warwickshire boost title hopes with two-day win vs Essex; Somerset still in title mix; Watch England's second T20 vs Sri Lanka live on Sky Sports Cricket and Sky Sports Main Event from 6pm on Thursday (6.30pm first ball) Wednesday 16 September 2026 21:07, UK Image: Chris Woakes was among the wickets as Warwickshire beat Essex inside two days in County Championship cricket Warwickshire boosted their Rothesay County Championship title challenge by securing an eight-wicket win over Essex in two days. Sam Hain's unbeaten 88 helped the Bears to a first-innings lead of 57 and then Manav Suthar's five for 75 saw Essex bowled out for 189 in their second innings. Zen Malik's 51 and an unbeaten 22 from Hain saw the visitors ease to their target of 133 for the loss of two wickets. Somerset also remain in the hunt for the title after putting themselves in a strong position against Yorkshire . messages.text: Djokovic to return to China Open on Sky Sports after 11-year absence

metadata.summary: Novak Djokovic has confirmed he will compete at the China Open this year, which runs from September 30-October 6 live on Sky Sports, marking a return to the event following an 11-year absence.
metadata.content: Novak Djokovic to return to ATP's China Open on Sky Sports after 11-year absence from event | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to content Novak Djokovic to return to ATP's China Open on Sky Sports after 11-year absence from event Novak Djokovic announces he will return to ATP Tour's China Open for first time since 2015 between September 30-October 6, live on Sky Sports; Decision comes following shock US Open first-round exit; watch Laver Cup at O2 in London from 25-27 September live on Sky Sports Wednesday 16 September 2026 19:37, UK Image: Novak Djokovic has announced he will return to the China Open for the first time in 11 years Novak Djokovic has confirmed he will compete at the China Open this year, which runs from September 30-October 6 live on Sky Sports , marking a return to the event following an 11-year absence. The 39-year-old recently dropped as low as No 12 in the world rankings following a shock first-round defeat to Argentina's Mariano Navone at the US Open. That defeat followed on from a third-round exit in May at the French Open - two underwhelming Grand Slam displays coming either side of a run to the semi-finals at Wimbledon, where he was well beaten in straight sets by eventual champion Jannik Sinner. Djokovic has not won a Grand Slam title since 2023, going three full calendar years without success.
